Section 1.0 Absolute Maximum Ratings, p. 3: maximum current into VDD pin 125 mA (out of VSS pin 150 mA). Chip, not board.

notes: VCC and VCC 2, GND and GND 2 are joined on the board (module internal), so one domain on VCC to GND covers both pads.
Nominal 3.3 V chosen; the chip runs from 1.8 to 5.5 V and the board has no regulator.
Per-pin limits on GPA0-GPA7 and GPB0-GPB7 only. GPA7 and GPB7 are output-only in this datasheet revision; the limit applies the same. INTA and INTB are not given limits.

The per-pin 25 mA is an absolute maximum (sunk or sourced), so it is entered as absMaxCurrent only; exceeding it is reported as over the absolute maximum. The datasheet gives no lower recommended per-pin current.
unaccounted: Power LED: none of the opened sources (digitaltown, ShillehTek manual, EasyEDA component page) show a power LED or a board schematic for the CJMCU-2317, so none is counted. If the board has one, its current is missing.
Any on-board pull-up resistors (I2C, RESET, address pins): no schematic found; their current depends on the pin states.
